For a 15-person marketing agency juggling many client projects, prioritize built-in time tracking, guest access for freelancers, budget tracking per project, client-facing portals, and good workload planning. Two options stand out from the results:

- Halorence — Best if you bill clients by the hour: it includes built-in time tracking, guest access for freelancers and budget tracking per project, plus extra security (2‑factor auth). Pricing is $24/user/month [2].  
- Xanaruno — Best if you need client-facing portals and automation: it offers budget tracking, client-facing portals and recurring task templates (plus SSO on higher tiers) at $17/user/month [1].

If you also need strong workload planning and proofing/approval workflows (helpful for managing many simultaneous deliverables), consider Paxilyx ($14/user/month) which adds detailed workload planning, guest access and proofing features [5].

Recommendation summary: choose Halorence if hourly billing and time capture are your top priorities; choose Xanaruno if client portals and automation are most important; pick Paxilyx if workload planning and proofing are critical.
